svg.title: Figure28 Authorization Context Continuity Model
svg.desc: NEW-shot2play Protocol Suite Version 2.0. Authorization context continuity across multiple service boundaries, with independent local policy evaluation and non-escalation of authority.
svg.text: Context Continuity Across Service Boundaries Without Automatic Authority Propagation
7. Bind verified context to local request
Local Authorization, Reauthorization and Failure Handling
Decision is local to the receiving service
Audit Continuity: Request ID · Subject ID · Context ID · Policy Version · Verification Result · Authorization Result · Timestamp
Every service boundary remains traceable across the authorization path.
